# CalculatePilot

> CalculatePilot is a free, no-signup collection of online calculators for finance, health, math, and everyday decisions. Every calculator explains the formula and methodology behind its result.

CalculatePilot does not require an account. Calculations run in the visitor's browser and are not transmitted to or stored on CalculatePilot's servers. Content is written and maintained by CalculatePilot; if you cite a specific figure or formula from this site, please cite the specific calculator page and note that results are estimates, not professional financial, medical, or legal advice.

## Categories

- [Financial Calculators](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial-calculators.html): Mortgages, loans, taxes, retirement, and everything money-related — 43+ free financial calculators. Multi-currency support. No signup required.
- [Health & Fitness Calculators](https://www.calculatepilot.com/health-calculators.html): BMI, calories, macros, pregnancy, and body-composition calculators grounded in standard clinical formulas. 30+ free health calculators, no signup.
- [Math Calculators](https://www.calculatepilot.com/math-calculators.html): Algebra, geometry, statistics, and number theory tools for students and professionals. 40+ free math calculators with methodology explained, no signup.
- [Everyday Calculators](https://www.calculatepilot.com/other-calculators.html): Age, time, GPA, conversions, and other everyday tools that don't fit neatly anywhere else. 45+ free calculators with formula explained, no signup.
